page.overview:
What is Public Safety Arc?

Public Safety Arc belongs to Chainsaw Man. The |Kōan Hen}}, officially referred to as Part 1: Public Safety Arc, is the first part of the Chainsaw Man series. Part 1 was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2018 until 2020. It is followed by the Academy Saga. It follows Denji as he spends his days working as a Devil Hunter at Public Safety.

Also known as: Part 1, Public Safety saga.
